name: Raghurajpur Pattachitra Heritage Village
description: India's first declared Heritage Crafts Village where every home is an active artisan studio. Preserves 5th-century Pattachitra cloth scroll painting and palm-leaf engraving.

name: Konark Sun Temple (The Black Pagoda)
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site built in 1250 CE. Colossal 24-wheeled sun chariot calculating time to the exact minute.

name: Ratnagiri & Lalitgiri Buddhist Viharas
description: Premier Buddhist academic monastic seat (5th-12th century CE) celebrated for its carved chlorite portal and Tantric Vajrayana stupas.
